title: Skyfall: The Ascendant Conflict (Part I)
summary:
Skyfall: The Ascendant Conflict (Part I)



● All pieces that are replaced will now be shuffled back into the deck
● Skywrath Mage ($2, Harpy/Mage): Skill <Arcane Bolt> 
● Vengeful Spirit ($1, Harpy/Undead/Demon Hunter): Updated race to Harpy/Undead.
● Viper: Skill reworked to <Viper Strike>
● New Race: Harpy (Current members include Vengeful Spirit, Skywrath Mage)
● Elf - Evasion: (9) Elves: When elves create illusions, they now gain a brief invisibility effect, causing enemies to temporarily lose their attack target.
● End-of-Season Reward Preview 
● Bug fix

Click the title link to check the full update details!
